items.label: 💖Classic Elegant Womens Watch
items.value: This fashionable and simple easy-to-read watch features a stainless steel bezel paired with a luxurious quartz movement,providing precise timekeeping and exuding an elegant charm.It is both simple and grand yet not lacking in fashion.Whether it's for business attendance,traveling,parties,participating in various events,or just for daily work, this elegant ladies' wristwatch is your ideal accessory.

items.label: 💖Business Dress Female Watch
items.value: Durable,clear,high-precision transparent coated mirror surface,scratch-resistant and wear-resistant.The Roman numeral scale and diamond Settings exude a luxurious atmosphere and are easy to read.It is equipped with a sturdy and durable stainless steel strap and a secure butterfly folding clasp,providing a comfortable wearing experience.

items.label: 💖Multifunction Watches for Women
items.value: The elegant and simple dial is full of charm and features three chronograph sub-dials (60- min,60 sec,24-h) and date window,offering you a variety of functions and suitable for many indoor and outdoor event scenarios.It is suitable to be given as a gift to the other party on Mother's Day,anniversaries,Thanksgiving Day,Christmas Day,etc.

items.label: 💖Luxury Waterproof&Luminous Watch
items.value: With a water resistance of 30M(100 ft),this ladies' watch is worry-free during rainy days,when water splashes from a sprinkler truck,or when washing hands and taking a shower.However,it is not suitable for hot water immersion,diving,or saunas.If you want to read clearly at night or in a dark environment,just activate the light-emitting function.

items.label: 💖OLEVS Ladies Watch
items.value: We offer a one-year warranty period.If you encounter any problems while using the women's multifunctional watch,please feel free to contact us through Amazon at any time.We will provide you with professional services.
